name: FCC Catalyst (Zeolite-based)
description: Fluid catalytic cracking catalyst based on USY zeolite in clay/alumina matrix, produced by spray drying.
source: Vogt & Weckhuysen, Fluid catalytic cracking: recent developments on the grand old lady of zeolite catalysis, Chem. Soc. Rev. 44, 7342-7370 (2015)
route_note: Citation grounds the route structure - FCC catalysts are spray-dried microspheres of USY zeolite in a clay/alumina matrix with binder - not the hourly rates, which remain the step library's own.
